answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the wharf of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wander of the next round.
